$sources: baseSliceMeters: the slice a work in the round stands on is its scan below 0.04 m, as the stages' sheets measured each cast's base (Data/Stages/classical-hall/Hang.json, the casts' notes: 'the scan's base slice (z < 0.04)').

widthToleranceMeters: the sheets write a scan's width to the millimetre (Hang.json `size`, from the same meshes); five millimetres is past any rounding, so a larger difference means the scan or the plan is not the one the other was measured from.
A cast's material is its medium's (Data/Art/Media.json); a part in another material is listed here.

Parts, the dancer's skirt: the bronzes wear a real cotton tulle skirt (the Salon's Hang.json note). Its band was measured on the collection's scan at the work's true height of 0.994 m: below 0.33 m the scan is the legs (0.16 m across), from 0.33 m it widens to the skirt (0.26 to 0.35 m across), and at 0.62 m it narrows to the bodice. The scan carries no colour, so the band also takes the hands clasped behind the back at the skirt's top.

parts.note: The bronze's cotton tulle skirt, from its hem to the waistband.
